checks.name: Code analysis
checks.about: Reads the source code looking for security bugs such as injection or unsafe data handling.

checks.name: Security rules
checks.about: Checks the code against thousands of known insecure patterns.

checks.name: Leaked passwords and keys
checks.about: Searches the whole history of the code for passwords, keys or tokens left in by mistake.

checks.name: Vulnerable libraries
checks.about: Compares every library used with public vulnerability databases.
checks.note: Includes libraries used only while building, which are not part of the installer. What ships is checked by the installer scan below.

checks.name: Installer scan
checks.about: Scans the finished installer for viruses and for vulnerable components, and lists everything inside it.

checks.name: Build pipeline safety
checks.about: Checks that the automated build cannot be tampered with or leak its credentials.

checks.name: Build script checks
checks.about: Checks the build scripts for unsafe or error-prone code.

checks.name: Security best practices
checks.about: Grades how the project is run: reviews, pinned dependencies, token permissions and more.
